title: Ayogya
desc: Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.

title: Namma Basava
desc: A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.

title: Yuddha Kaanda
desc: A corrupt advocate falsely accuses a commoner of murder and sends him to the gallows. Eventually, the commoner's son becomes a lawyer and embarks on a quest for revenge.

title: Habba
desc: A dark secret from Seetha's past keeps her from marrying Ram, her lover. Luckily for the couple, Ram's brothers are determined to get them back together.

title: Anuraga Aralithu
desc: Shankar, a factory worker, is forced to marry his employer's daughter who is arrogant. He decides to teach her a lesson in order to make her realize her fault.
